name: Breezy HR
summary: Recruiting and applicant tracking made simple. Post jobs to 50+ boards, manage candidates on a visual pipeline, and automate scheduling and screening.
best_for: small teams hiring for a few roles at once that want a visual, drag-and-drop pipeline without enterprise-ATS pricing
skip_if: you hire once or twice a year — the free single-position plan is plenty, and the paid jump only pays off with concurrent open roles
honest_knock: The jump from free (one position) to the first paid tier is steep if you only hire occasionally — the free plan is genuinely usable, so live in it until you're filling several roles at once.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and re-read unchanged 2026-09-27) A genuinely permanent free Bootstrap plan: one open position, unlimited users. Paid, annual against monthly: Startup $157/mo or $189, Growth $273/mo or $329, Business $439/mo or $529, plus a custom-quoted Pro tier. Every paid tier includes unlimited users and unlimited positions, which is what separates it from per-seat applicant tracking. Onboarding is a separate product, starting at $49/mo for automated role-based workflows that sync with the ATS. The same page, read 27 September 2026, offers a 14-day full-feature trial with no card and 100,000 Breezy Intelligence credits included; further AI credits start at $30 per 100,000 and SMS credits at $41 a month.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 29 October 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We created a private candidate pool, added two made-up candidates by hand, exported them and put the Startup plan in the cart without paying.
findings: Billing said 'You have 13 days left on your trial' on the day we signed up, with the trial ending on 12 November: 14 calendar days. All features are open during the trial. The app switched itself to Dutch.
A candidate has to belong to a position or pool. We used a pool so nothing was posted; its default stages had no automatic actions, and AI scoring was off.
Breezy showed a warning that the account is not yet verified and that, without verification, positions are not posted to job sites; it asks you to contact support through the chat.

The candidate export kept names with accents, email addresses, the pool and the stage. It has no column for the summary we typed, so that text did not come back, and the requisition ID column was empty.
Startup monthly went into a cart showing '$189' and 'Pay now $189', with no tax shown before paying. Annual billing (15% off) is preselected on the plans page, where Startup is $157 a month.

Members can only be Administrator or Member, with no viewer role. A free Bootstrap plan is offered; it keeps full access to candidates from the last 30 days only. The REST API and Zapier are listed in the trial.
